g.text: Codex Development Workflow - Unified PR-Gated Lifecycle
Read current state + architecture + relevant code
Plan contains one or more Tickets
Update canonical owner + docs index; skip when nothing changed
Persist one Plan Issue and all child Ticket Issues
before the Plan branch. The Plan owns one branch,
one PR, and one merge; all Tickets and Slices share it.
Ticket dependencies order work on that branch and
Every requirement has exactly one Plan and at least one Ticket; a small requirement
uses one Ticket with one Slice.
Invoke immediately after the PR is ready.
Only PASS permits merge. BLOCKED returns to
Fix -> Test -> Documentation impact when applicable
-> Redaction when applicable -> Commit -> Push -> pr-review.
Review execution recovery is an implementation detail.
Main agent owns integration and final judgment.
No overlapping files or shared interfaces in parallel.
Failed validation -> fix and rerun affected checks.
More Slices -> repeat implementation and validation.
Publication waits for the whole Plan's acceptance.
Verify actual push URL(s) and destination branch.
Unknown targets and default-branch publication block.
All file types require a PR; never direct-push main.
Update the recovery snapshot only after merge,
If tracked State / Docs change, use the same
Plan-branch and PR gate for that follow-up change.
Docs, Code, Tests, Config, Refactor, Bugfix,
Feature, Dependency, and CI/CD changes all use
this lifecycle. No direct default-branch delivery.
